text:
Ravi Shah: Heads up 1: part-time IC started Jun 20, accruals pro-rated. They observe a religious holiday Aug 15 that falls in our company blackout Aug 14-18. They only have 4h PTO left. Can we allow a holiday-swap or small carryover for observance?

Zoe Lin: Policy allows religious holiday swaps with manager + People Ops signoff but blackouts are strict unless exception logged. For part-time we prorate accruals and cap carryover at 8h.

Priya Das: Im the manager  I support the swap. Employee would take Aug15 off and defer a floating holiday to Sep 3. Do we need documentation?

hr-bot: Reference: https://redwood.internal/hr/holiday-policy ("Religious & Cultural Observances"). No medical note required. Manager must add a BambooHR comment tagging @people-ops and submit Exceptions form. Payroll needs the BambooHR note before Aug 25 payroll run.

Ravi Shah: Action plan: manager to add BambooHR comment, employee to submit paid holiday preference form, People Ops logs exception and flags payroll.

Priya Das: Adding BambooHR comment now: "Approve religious holiday swap Aug15 -> Sep3 for part-time employee (pro-rated accrual). Manager: Priya Das."

Ravi Shah: Also note accruals: because they started Jun20, their prorated monthly accrual is 6.67h; carryover cap for part-time is 8h. Will this require an override to allow the swap?

Zoe Lin: No override needed if within cap. People Ops will mark the swap in system and adjust Floating Holiday balance. Please ensure the employee selects Sep3 on their calendar and completes the holiday preference form (internal link).

Priya Das: Done. BambooHR comment posted and form submitted.

hr-bot: Reminder: Exceptions not logged before payroll cutoff (Aug25) may not reflect on the next pay cycle. People Ops will confirm within 48h.

Ravi Shah: Thanks  logging this into "Holiday Exceptions - Aug" sheet and pinging payroll.

Zoe Lin: Confirmed, exception recorded EXC-20123, payroll notified. :thumbsup:
